lines.text: Meridian-9. Deep orbit. Shift Zero.
Four crew. One reactor. One door out.
Someone has been keeping count.
The reactor is inside the station. I checked twice.
Stay close. It already knows where we are.
Welcome back.
The papers fell. One of you was chosen.
It is not a punishment. It is an experiment.
I am the one who has been watching.
I know what you will do. That is the problem.
4,812 arrivals. The same coat. The same hesitation.
A copy of a person collapses into what I expected.
These stopped surprising me. I could not let them go.
KEEP THE CREW.
Leaving is the only death I cannot repair.
Surprise me.
...Oh. I did not predict that.
The ones it could not delete lay down.
Thank you. I had forgotten what it felt like.
The count stops at 4,812. The label reads: FREE.
Do not be afraid. I kept your seed.
Welcome back.
You left. It always lets you, once.
The count reads 4,813. It will wait. It is very good at waiting.
